description: Lost the request_id of a request you submitted? Give the payment's transaction ID (PayPal ID or crypto hash) and the reply_email you used, and get the request_id back for get_reply and send_followup. Both must match. It's also in the confirmation email. At most 20 lookups per hour from one address.

reply_email.description: The reply_email you submitted the request with

transaction_id.description: The payment's transaction ID: the PayPal ID, or the crypto hash you passed as crypto_tx

name: find_request
